Divide the frame into thirds both horizontally and vertically. Place the subject at intersection points or along the lines for a more harmonious and natural composition.
Place the subject at the center of the frame to emphasize its importance. Ideal for symmetrical or formal scenes.
Use roads, rivers, and other lines to guide the viewer\'s gaze, creating depth and direction.
Use reflective surfaces, architecture, and other symmetrical elements to create balance and order with strong visual impact.

The AI engine analyzes the subject position in your viewfinder in real-time, combining classic composition rules like the rule of thirds to calculate the optimal composition. Supports Fast (lightweight) and Pro (high-precision) modes.

The tracking system integrates gyroscope sensor data for physics-level smooth guidance. When the subject aligns with the optimal composition position, the tracking dot turns green and displays alignment markers.
Automatically triggers the shutter when the perfect composition is aligned. Supports custom delay capture.
With auto capture enabled, the AI will automatically take a photo when it detects the composition has reached the optimal state. You can also set a delay timer to give yourself time to prepare.

Thank you for using GouMiao LiveCapture! Before using this app, please carefully read and understand the relevant privacy policy and user agreement.
. If you agree, please click \"Agree and Continue\" to start using this app.

GouMiao LiveCapture (hereinafter referred to as \"this App\") is an on-device AI-powered intelligent photography assistant. We understand the importance of your personal information and will treat it with the utmost care in compliance with applicable laws and regulations. This Privacy Policy will help you understand: how we collect and use your personal information, how we store and protect your personal information, and how you can manage your personal information. This App promises: all AI inference is performed locally on your device, with no network data transmission whatsoever.

This App requires access to your device camera for real-time viewfinding and composition guidance. The camera feed is used solely for real-time composition analysis and guidance, and will not be recorded, captured, or uploaded to any server. Camera frame data is processed in memory only while you are using the shooting feature, and is released when the shooting feature is closed. No cache is retained.

Photos you capture are saved to your device\'s local gallery via the system MediaStore. Photos are stored only on your device\'s local storage and are never uploaded to any cloud server or remote storage. You can view, delete, or manage your photos at any time through the system gallery. This App will not save any photos without your explicit action.

This App uses the device\'s gyroscope and accelerometer sensors for motion detection and composition stability assessment. Sensor data is used solely for detecting device motion and assisting real-time composition guidance. Sensor data is processed in real-time in memory only, and is never recorded, stored, or uploaded. All sensor data is immediately released when the app is closed.

This App uses the TensorFlow Lite framework to run AI models (MobileNetV3) locally on your device for real-time composition analysis and scoring. AI inference is performed entirely on your device locally, does not depend on any network connection, and does not send any data to any server. AI model files are bundled within the app installation package and are not dynamically downloaded or updated.

This App does not include any network communication functionality. This App does not use HTTP/HTTPS requests, WebSocket, TCP/UDP sockets, or any other network communication methods. This App will not upload any of your data to servers, nor will it download any data from servers. This App can run completely in an offline environment.

This App does not integrate any third-party SDKs that may collect user personal information. This App does not include any advertising SDKs, analytics SDKs, push notification SDKs, or social sharing SDKs. The technical components used by this App (TensorFlow Lite, Android Jetpack, DataStore, etc.) are all locally-running frameworks without network data collection capabilities.

This App only retains the following data locally on your device:

1. Photos you actively capture (stored in the local gallery via MediaStore, which you can manage yourself);
2. App preference settings (stored in the app's private directory via DataStore, automatically cleared when the app is uninstalled).

This App does not retain any of your data outside of your device. To delete all data, you can clear app data in system settings or uninstall this App.

This App may revise this Privacy Policy from time to time. When the terms of this Privacy Policy change, we will notify you through in-app dialogs or announcements. If you continue to use this App after the Privacy Policy changes, it means you accept the revised Privacy Policy.
